title: Topological defects in reflection positive topological field theories
summary: Topological defects in quantum field theories are believed to assemble into higher categories with extra structure. This has been made precise for defects in $2$- and $3$-dimensional oriented topological quantum field theories by Davydov, Kong, and Runkel and by Carqueville, Meusburger, and Schaumann, respectively. In this paper we study the extra structure present on these categories when the topological field theory is additionally reflection positive.
